constraints: Never contact a real AI model or non-loopback forge during regression tests
description: Reproduce the PR 5 boundary, isolation, privacy, resource-limit and recovery failures without live services.
rationale: The reviewed failure modes need executable coverage to prevent regressions; these tests use fake providers, local Git fixtures and loopback HTTP only.
requirements: Reject malformed model references without losing valid findings
Enforce Git isolation, secret redaction and provider output and cost bounds
Retry partial evidence and interrupted promotions without corrupting canonical intent
title: Review regressions protect true-up trust boundaries and recovery
